description: List sporting events / fixtures (the spine of the API). Each event carries home/away team, start time, status and whether live odds exist (hasOdds). Filter by league, team, status or start-time window, then use the returned event id with get_event_odds. Paginate with cursor.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor. Pass the `nextCursor` from a previous response to fetch the next page.

league.description: League slug (e.g. mlb, wnba, mls, pga-tour, fifa-world-cup). See list_leagues.

limit.description: Max rows to return (page size). Default 50, server caps apply.

starts_after.description: ISO-8601 timestamp; only events starting at/after this time.

starts_before.description: ISO-8601 timestamp; only events starting at/before this time.

status.description: Event status filter (e.g. scheduled, live, final).

team_id.description: Filter to events involving this team UUID (from list_teams).

name: list_events
